title: Dynamic Quadtree Tokenization and Transformer for Adaptive Mesh PDE Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.04044v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The quadratic attention cost of Vision Transformers (ViTs) forces a trade-off between spatial resolution and rollout horizon, particularly for fine-scale PDEs where shocks, reaction fronts, and material interfaces occupy small, evolving regions of the domain. Conventional neural surrogates also lack mechanisms to adapt resolution dynamically. We propose WAMRViT, a ViT that tokenizes inputs as balanced quadtrees using a wavelet-inspired refinement criterion, jointly encodes position and refinement level with 3D rotary positional embeddings, and regrids in cell space during inference for stable long-horizon rollouts. A multi-scale variant retains each leaf at its native source resolution and lets the model learn across resolution levels. translated_title: 用于自适应网格PDE预测的动态四叉树标记化与Transformer
translated_abstract: 视觉Transformer（ViT）二次方复杂度的注意力计算开销迫使模型在空间分辨率与滚动预测时域之间做出权衡，这对于细尺度PDE问题尤为突出，因为其中的激波、反应前沿和材料界面仅占据求解域中较小且不断演化的区域。传统神经代理模型也缺乏动态调整分辨率的机制。我们提出了WAMRViT，这是一种视觉Transformer，它使用受小波启发的细化判据将输入标记化为平衡四叉树，通过3D旋转位置编码联合编码位置与细化层级，并在推理过程中在单元空间中进行重网格化，以实现稳定的长时程滚动预测。其多尺度变体在每个叶节点保留其原始源分辨率，使模型能够跨分辨率层级进行学习。与固定预算的自适应标记化方法不同，WAMRViT不预设标记数量，并在整个自回归滚动过程中支持完全自适应的拓扑结构。据我们所知，它是首个……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出WAMRViT，一种基于动态四叉树标记化与小波细化判据的视觉Transformer，无需预设标记数量即可自适应调整网格分辨率，实现对细尺度PDE的长时程稳定预测。
en_tdlr: WAMRViT, a Vision Transformer with dynamic quadtree tokenization and wavelet-inspired refinement, enables fully adaptive-resolution, stable long-horizon PDE forecasting without predetermined token budgets.
